name: Edge0-35B-A3B Preview

lineage.how_derived: int4 quantization with Recover-LoRA (distillation from the FP teacher) plus a trained prerouter head that predicts expert routing one step ahead; adapters stay unmerged

purpose: Run a 35B-class MoE in phone-class memory (under 3 GiB active): expert weights stay on storage and are streamed on demand by the edge0 inference framework (native engines for iOS, macOS, Android, Windows) (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0; the repo has no LICENSE file, text not read. Base Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is Apache-2.0 in our database.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus full attention MoE (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B)
architecture.drafter: prerouter head (predicts expert routing, not tokens)
architecture.why_this_design: SSD expert offload keeps only active weights in RAM; the prerouter overlaps expert loads with the forward pass (up to +59 percent decode throughput, grows with storage latency); Recover-LoRA recovers int4 quality (card).

variants.format: MLX int4 (affine, group 64) plus LoRA and prerouter adapters
variants.notes: larger siblings Edge0-120B and Edge0-145B (NVFP4, q3k) and an 8B-A1B preview exist; not examined

variants.format: int4 plus LoRA and prerouter adapters (edge0 engine)
variants.notes: 8B-class MoE, vendor claims under 1 GiB active memory and 25 tok/s; 2.9k downloads, 118 likes; card not read beyond the header

pc-12gb.notes: 19.74 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-16gb.notes: 19.74 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-24gb.notes: 19.74 GB file fits the VRAM budget (21.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-32gb.notes: 19.74 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.notes: vendor-measured (not ours) 14.9-17.7 tok/s decode and 113/140 tok/s prefill (cold/warm) on a Mac mini M4 Pro 24 GB at 2.9 GiB peak active memory, short context

mac-32gb.notes: 19.74 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 19.74 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

other: edge0 native engines (open source, iOS, macOS, Android, Windows)
engine_support.notes: Only runs on the vendor's engine with its adapters.

benchmarks.name: AIME 2026
benchmarks.variant: int4 + adapters; Qwen3.6-35B-A3B fp16 92.7; run by the vendor with OpenCompass

strengths: 35B-class quality in about 3 GiB resident memory on a Mac mini
the prerouter idea (predict next-step experts to hide SSD latency) is directly relevant to our expert streaming
weaknesses: 15 tok/s decode on an M4 Pro, short contexts only
preview; runs only on the vendor engine
soft.maturity: 1.1k likes, 6k downloads; an accompanying paper is tagged (arXiv 2609.18063, not read)

tona_fit.reason: As a model it is a lossy Qwen3.6-35B-A3B; the interest is the technique (learned prerouter plus Recover-LoRA for SSD-streamed experts), which maps to our Mac and low-RAM paths. Base is older than Qwen3.8-27B.
blockers: weights only usable with the vendor engine

open_questions: paper details: prerouter accuracy and cost
whether the prerouter head can be trained for other MoE models
